Hi Daniel / Aisha —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive with our ML and infra leads:

Suggested next step: 60–90 minute technical deep dive where we can:
- Walk through your primary inference workloads and request/traffic patterns
- Review model variant candidates and quantization strategy options
- Demo Redwood’s serving topology (routing, fallback, cache) and operational runbook
- Align success criteria for the PoC (SLOs, cost targets, data retention)

Please let me know approximate attendee roster on your side (ML lead, infra/SRE, security/compliance contact) and whether 60 or 90 minutes is preferred. Below are a few windows from our side next week — tell us what works and we’ll send a calendar invite: 

Option A: Thu, Jul 29 — 10:00–11:30 PT (90m)
Option B: Fri, Jul 30 — 13:00–14:30 PT (90m)
Option C: Tue, Aug 3 — 09:00–10:00 PT (60m)

Attached: auriga-PoC-scope.pdf (proposal draft) — this has the sample dataset and success metrics we discussed; tdx-precall-checklist.docx (short preparatory checklist for your SRE/ML owner).

If you prefer a different cadence (two shorter sessions vs one long), call that out and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Best,
